title: Medical Technologist Salary Guide
summary: Learn what you can expect for a medical technologist salary and how factors such as location, experience, certifications, and employer affect earning potential.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


-


The average medical technologist salary is $111,000, including base salary and additional forms of compensation like bonuses and commissions, according to data from Glassdoor \[[1](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/us-medical-technologist-salary-SRCH_IL.0,2_IN1_KO3,23.htm) \].


-


A medical laboratory technologist salary depends on a range of factors, such as years of experience, education level, and location.


-


Earning a certification from the American Society of Clinical Pathologists can help you showcase your skills and increase your medical lab technologist salary potential.


The average medical technologist salary may improve if you consider pursuing opportunities in specific industries, continuing your education, or relocating to a high-paying city. Discover how various factors can impact your earning potential as a medical technologist in this article.


If you’re ready to get your start, consider enrolling in the[Patient Safety Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/patient-safety) from Johns Hopkins University. You’ll have the opportunity to gain experience with tools and knowledge to develop a patient safety improvement plan and identify the key contributing factors to a strong culture of patient safety.


###


## What does a medical technologist do?


Medical technologists, sometimes called clinical laboratory scientists or[medical laboratory scientists](https://www.coursera.org/articles/medical-laboratory-technician) , perform various tests and assessments in medical settings to assist clinicians and hospital staff. As a medical technologist, you are responsible for helping clinicians make patient-care decisions based on the information you give them. This could include reading pregnancy tests, analyzing blood samples, preparing tissue samples, and conducting genomic testing. This career field offers a fast-paced environment and the opportunity to impact patients' lives behind the scenes positively.


## What is a medical laboratory technologist salary?


According to Glassdoor, the median total pay, which includes base salary and additional forms of compensation like bonuses and commissions, for medical technologists is $111,000 \[[1](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/us-medical-technologist-salary-SRCH_IL.0,2_IN1_KO3,23.htm) \]. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reports a median annual salary of $62,930 for clinical laboratory technologists and technicians, with an expected annual growth rate of 3 percent \[[2](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/clinical-laboratory-technologists-and-technicians.htm) \].


## Factors that impact medical technologist salary


While national salary averages are beneficial in giving an idea of what you can expect to earn in a medical technologist position, actual income will vary depending on various factors. For example, San Francisco's cost of living is 89 percent higher than the national average, so most positions would likely have higher salaries to help employees cover the cost of living \[[3](https://www.salary.com/research/cost-of-living/san-francisco-ca) \].


When comparing paychecks between different opportunities, consider the influences of[education](https://www.coursera.org/articles/medical-majors) , certification, experience, position title, employer, and location.


### What is a medical lab technologist salary by education level?


In many industries, higher educational attainment leads to higher pay. A[bachelor’s degree](https://www.coursera.org/degrees/bachelors) in medical technology or a related field is generally recommended for medical technologists.


For those who do not have a related[bachelor’s degree](https://www.coursera.org/articles/how-to-get-a-bachelors-degree) , completing a medical technologist program accredited by the National Accrediting Agency of Clinical Laboratory Science (NAACLS) is an alternative to prepare you for entering this career field.


After meeting educational requirements, medical technologists must complete a certain number of proctored hours in the lab. Completing additional education, such as obtaining a higher degree or concentrated education in a particular area, can help you prepare to take on more duties in the laboratory and may help you negotiate a higher salary.


According to Zippia, the average medical technologist's salary figures based on educational level are \[[4](https://www.zippia.com/medical-technologist-jobs/education/) \]:


-


**High school diploma:** $47,294


-


[Associate degree](https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-is-an-associate-degree-key-information-to-know) **:** $52,683


-


**Bachelor's degree:** $58,081


-


[Master's degree](https://www.coursera.org/degrees/masters) **:** $59,681


-


**Doctorate degree:** $59,065


**Read more:**[Is College Worth It?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/is-college-worth-it)


### What is a medical technologist salary by certification


While the US does not have a national certification requirement for medical technologists, several states look for board certification from the American Society for Clinical Pathology. Even if your state does not require this certification, completing the examination process may be advantageous during hiring. Payscale reports the average annual salary for individuals with American Society for Clinical Pathology certification as $82,000 \[[5](https://www.payscale.com/research/US/Certification=American_Society_of_Clinical_Pathology_(ASCP)/Salary) \].


Additional certifications may also help you showcase your professional skills, allowing you to perform additional tasks and stand out in your role. Every year, the American Society of Clinical Pathologists (ASCP) offers certification exams in the following areas, each of which can add credentials to your resume and boost your earning potential. Based on your interests and intended career path, consider the following:


-


Medical Lab Scientist: MLS (ASCP)


-


Cytologist: CT (ASCP)


-


Histotechnologist: HTL (ASCP)


-


Scientist in Blood Banking: BB (ASCP)


-


Scientist in Chemistry: C (ASCP)


-


Scientist in Cytogenetics: CG (ASCP)


-


Scientist in Hematology: H (ASCP)


-


Scientist in Microbiology: M (ASCP)


-


Scientist in Molecular Biology: MB (ASCP)


###


### What is a medical technologist salary by experience?


The salary for a medical technologist typically shows a significant increase with years of experience. According to Glassdoor, medical technologists with 15 or more years of experience can expect to earn over $40,000 more annually than medical technologists in their first year professionally \[[1](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/us-medical-technologist-salary-SRCH_IL.0,2_IN1_KO3,23.htm) \]. In general, you can expect salary growth to follow this typical pattern of median total salaries as experience increases \[[1](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/us-medical-technologist-salary-SRCH_IL.0,2_IN1_KO3,23.htm) \]:


-


**0–1 year of experience:** $80,000


-


**1–3 years of experience:** $89,000


-


**4–6 years of experience:** $100,000


-


**7–9 years of experience:** $107,000


-


**10–14 years of experience:** $115,000


-


**15+ years of experience:** $130,000


*All salary information represents the median total pay from Glassdoor as of September 2026. These figures include base salary and additional pay, which may represent profit-sharing, commissions, bonuses, or other compensation.*


### What is a medical technologist salary by position title?


Often related to education and experience, your position title is likely to correlate with earning potential. For example, a senior medical technologist brings in a median total pay of $138,000, according to Glassdoor \[[6](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/senior-medical-technologist-salary-SRCH_KO0,27.htm) \], which is nearly $30,000 higher than the median total pay of $111,000 \[[1](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/us-medical-technologist-salary-SRCH_IL.0,2_IN1_KO3,23.htm) \] for a medical technologist. If you are in a medical technologist role and believe that your skills and job responsibilities warrant higher pay,[discussing a title change](https://www.coursera.org/articles/how-to-negotiate-salary) or transition into a new position with your employer may lead to a salary increase.


###


### What is a medical technologist salary by employer?


The type of company you work for, such as a public hospital versus a private practice, may influence your yearly salary. Your organization's team size, company growth, and managerial responsibilities can affect your earning potential.

-


**Merchant wholesalers, nondurable goods** : $105,070


-


**Social advocacy organizations:** $87,830


-


**Specialty (except psychiatric and substance abuse) hospitals:** $82,780


-


**Federal executive branch:** $82,270


-


**Medical equipment and supplies manufacturing:** $80,780


-


**Outpatient care centers:** $73,980


-


**Professional and commercial equipment and supplies merchant wholesalers:** $72,780


-


**General medical and surgical hospitals:** $71,820


-


**Management, scientific, and technical consulting services:** $70,580


According to Zippia, the companies that pay medical technologists the highest salaries are \[[8](https://www.zippia.com/salaries/medical-technologist/) \]:


-

-


**American Red Cross:** $67,988


-


**Mount Auburn Hospital:** $66,733


-


**Club Staffing:** $66,561


-


**Concord Hospital:** $66,514


-


**Health First:** $66,391


-


**Miriam Hospital:** $66,154


-


**Dana-Farber Cancer Institute:** $66,067


-


**Brigham and Women's Hospital:** $66,052


-


**University of Washington:** $65,982


### What is a medical technologist salary by location?


Regarding salary, keeping location and related cost of living in mind is important to ensure you earn a high enough salary to live comfortably. Generally, salaries in larger cities are higher due to the higher cost of living, demand, and quality of medical facilities. According to the BLS, medical technologists earn the highest salaries in New York, Oregon, the District of Columbia, Vermont, and California. Expected earnings are as follows \[[7](https://data.bls.gov/oesprofile/?major_group=290000&occupation=292010&measure=04&areas=INDUSTRY,STATE,MSA) \]:


-


**New York:** $93,610


-


**Oregon:** $83,900


-


**District of Columbia:** $81,650


-


**Vermont:** $80,100


-


**California:** $78,840


For traveling medical technologists, salary will also vary widely by location. According to ZipRecruiter, the average hourly salary for a traveling medical technologist is $35.24, with an average annual salary of $73,307 \[[9](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/Salaries/Travel-Medical-Technologist-Salary#Yearly) \]. The cities that pay the highest include \[[10](https://www.indeed.com/career/medical-technologist/salaries?salaryType=YEARLY) \]:


-


**Huntsville, AL:** $103,945


-


**Austin, TX:** $102,447


-


**Atlanta, GA:** 96,992


-


**Chicago, IL:** $78,800


-


**Pendleton, OR:** $60,196


As a traveling medical technologist, it may be important to consider areas with higher salaries and higher costs of living to ensure you make smart decisions and seek opportunities that support your desired lifestyle.


### Who gets paid more, MLT or MLS?


A medical laboratory scientist generally earns more than a medical laboratory technician. This is due to scientists typically holding more advanced degrees compared to technicians, as well as a greater responsibility when it comes to performing tests and making decisions in the workplace.


## How do the salaries of similar positions compare?


Medical technologists earn a high wage due to their advanced education, specialized training, and in-demand expertise. When looking at related positions to determine the right career path for you, you can expect earning potential based on the following total median salaries from similar careers:


-


**Phlebotomist:** $47,000 \[[11](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/phlebotomist-salary-SRCH_KO0,12.htm) \]


-


**Biological technician:** $52,000 \[[12](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/us-biological-technician-salary-SRCH_IL.0,2_IN1_KO3,24.htm) \]


-


**Clinical technician:** $56,000 \[[13](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/clinical-technician-salary-SRCH_KO0,19.htm) \]


-


**Medical assistant:** $44,000 \[[14](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salaries/medical-assistant-salary-SRCH_KO0,17.htm) \]
